title: Certify nullspace completeness before recycled-bit initializer admission
body:
PR2537 explicitly notes that dropping a nullspace vector can make the nesting replay too permissive. This opt-in package closes its Open next question 4 with a fail-closed admission guard: exact annihilation, an independent full-row-rank witness for the proposed basis, and a complementary input-rank lower bound. Rank-nullity proves completeness. Exact fallback handles unlucky primes, and the guard also rejects duplicated or zero rows that a row-count-only check could miss.

The unchanged PR2537 kernel at `222063b96ec1a109a8c9f40e5d615498a737c6dd` is source-authenticated before extraction. The actual unchanged h=23 `Exact` initializer passes all 4,473 calls; deleting or duplicating a row from an actual basis is rejected. Independent determinant enumeration covers 864 small integer matrices, with 11 semantic rejection controls, two unlucky-prime fallback cases and valid noncanonical basis acceptance. The standalone guard controls also pass under optimized Python.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12.7 replay, Git-free optimized export, three changed-source rejections before execution and a typed receipt corruption rejection. Separate AI proof/code review and isolated optimized controls passed. Source commits, Git blobs, hashes, exact commands and scope limits are in the package. Canonical main was refreshed and remains `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`.

This preserves production files and certificate pins. Coverage is the complete initializer, not the all-key/move/scalar replay. The guard certifies the rational nullspace, not canonical normalization or output order; PR2537's existing equivalence audit remains distinct. No native cost reduction, new supplier, speedup, selected exponent, formalization or maintainer acceptance is claimed. The standard rank argument is credited; thakrarsagar's kernel and documented gap, Douglas Colkitt's integration, and Zhihao Chen/Swapnil Jain's frozen ledger and frame sources retain attribution. New work by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Open next question: integrate the guard in the production installer and perform a full `--all` replay with measured cost and a reviewed certificate-pin update.
